## Description
Provide a summary of the changes and the rationale behind them.

## Related Issues
Fixes #[issue-number]

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Database migration required

## Checklist
- [ ] I have run `npm run lint` and resolved any issues
- [ ] I have run `npm run typecheck` and verified 0 compiler errors
- [ ] I have run `npm run test:unit` and all tests passed
- [ ] I have updated the `CHANGELOG.md` with my changes
- [ ] Database schema changes (if any) have been migrated and tested
